name: ApexFlsViolationRule
description: Identifies data read/write operations that may not have CRUD/FLS

name: ApexNullPointerExceptionRule
description: Identifies Apex operations that dereference null objects and throw NullPointerExceptions.

name: AvoidDatabaseOperationInLoop
description: Detects database operations inside loops, which can cause degraded performance.

name: AvoidMultipleMassSchemaLookups
description: Detects mass schema lookups that can cause performance degradation if made more than once in a path. These methods are: Schema.getGlobalDescribe() and Schema.describeSObjects(...). Flagged lookups include those within a loop or multiple invocations in a path.

name: PerformNullCheckOnSoqlVariables
description: Identifies SOQL queries with variables in WHERE clauses that lack null checks.

name: RemoveUnusedMethod
description: Identifies methods that aren't invoked from recognized entry points.

name: UnimplementedTypeRule
description: Identifies abstract classes and interfaces that are non-global and don't have implementations or extensions.

name: UseWithSharingOnDatabaseOperation
description: Identifies a database operation executed outside of a "with sharing" policy. Warns when DML or SOQL operations inherit sharing rules implicitly instead of explicitly.
